versos.texto_bv: O rei lhes disse: "Tive um sonho, e meu espírito se perturbou até saber o sonho."
versos.traducao_literal: E-disse a-eles o-rei: sonho sonhei; e-perturbou-se meu-espírito para-saber o-sonho.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): 'se perturbou até saber o sonho' expressa limite temporal, mas a literal expressa finalidade/ansiedade ('perturbou-se para saber'); a correção de forma natural ('para saber' ou 'está perturbado para saber') exigiria mudar o sentido do texto publicado, o que é vedado nesta etapa. — evidência: traducao_literal: 'e-perturbou-se meu-espírito para-saber o-sonho'; ARA: 'para saber o sonho está perturbado o meu espírito'; NVIPT: 'que me perturba e quero saber o que significa'.

kjv.texto: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

vizinhos.2: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
vizinhos.4: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.

web.texto: The king said to them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.

vizinhos.2: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the enchanters, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.
vizinhos.4: Then spoke the Chaldeans to the king in the Syrian language, O king, live forever: tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.
